consequence.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts now have the Kafka resource as the regardingObject instead of the Pod; field-selectors filtering by Pod regardingObject will no longer match these events.

original.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the regardingObject; they now reference the Kafka resource instead.

decision.reason: [ev-2dffc916b09a] says Pod-restart events no longer have the Pod as the `regardingObject`, and that users who filter events with a `regardingObject` field-selector must update it to specify the Kafka resource. The events are still emitted, just attached to a different object. The proposal's behavior-change kind and its statement that Pod-based selectors will no longer match these events follow directly from that text. The evidence says "must update" but does not say that anything fails or is rejected, so I did not raise this to a mandatory-work kind. Confidence is low because that "must" wording could also be read as a required migration.
